description: Get schools within a neighborhood — public, charter, and private. Includes quality ratings, grade levels, contact info. Use count_only for a quick summary, or limit/offset to page the full list (the response reports total/returned).

count_only.description: Return only counts by governance type

limit.description: Max schools to return (ignored when count_only)

offset.description: Number of schools to skip, for paging through the full list

name: get-schools
